days.working_title: Space Isn’t Completely Silent—It’s Full of Waves We Can’t Hear
days.objective: Help curious learners understand space through visual storytelling.
days.hook: Vacuum blocks ordinary sound, yet pressure waves still move through plasma, gas, and magnetic fields across space.

days.working_title: If Time Ran 10× Faster, Your Body Would Notice First
days.objective: Help curious learners understand time through visual storytelling.
days.hook: A faster clock would reshape sleep, healing, memory, and aging before society could adjust its schedule.

days.working_title: Your Brain Edits Reality Before You Ever See It
days.objective: Help curious learners understand human perspective through visual storytelling.
days.hook: Every glance is compressed, corrected, and partly invented before it reaches conscious awareness.

days.working_title: How One Drop Can Spend 1,000 Years Crossing the Ocean
days.objective: Help curious learners understand ocean through visual storytelling.
days.hook: A single parcel of seawater can circle the planet on a journey longer than many civilizations have existed.

days.working_title: Your Brain Deletes Details Every Time You Look Away
days.objective: Help curious learners understand brain through visual storytelling.
days.hook: The gaps in your attention feel invisible because your brain replaces missing detail with a convincing guess.

days.working_title: The Invisible Threshold Between a Tree Stand and a Living Forest
days.objective: Help curious learners understand nature through visual storytelling.
days.hook: A collection of trees becomes a resilient forest only when hidden relationships begin recycling water, nutrients, and life.

days.working_title: The Observable Universe Is 93 Billion Light-Years Wide—So Why Is It 13.8 Billion Years Old?
days.objective: Help curious learners understand universe through visual storytelling.
days.hook: Cosmic expansion makes the universe far larger than a simple light-travel calculation suggests.
